seo.title: Pressure Easy — Private Blood Pressure Tracker for iPhone and Apple Watch
seo.description: Track blood pressure privately. Every reading in its American Heart Association category, your 7- and 30-day averages, trends and a PDF report for your doctor. Apple Watch, widgets and optional Apple Health. No accounts, no tracking.

hero.label: BLOOD PRESSURE TRACKER
hero.title: Know your numbers, privately.
text: Add a reading in seconds and see its American Heart Association category in plain words, with your 7- and 30-day averages right beside it. A clear PDF for your doctor when you need one. No account, no cloud, no tracking.

items.title: Today at a glance
items.text: Your latest reading in big, clear numbers, its category in words, and your 7- and 30-day averages. A reading above normal carries a small mark, so it's easy to spot.

items.title: AHA categories, in plain words
items.text: Normal, elevated, stage 1, stage 2 or hypertensive crisis, exactly as the American Heart Association defines them. A very high reading comes with a calm note on when to contact your doctor or emergency services.

items.title: Trends
items.text: A chart of every reading from 7 days to a year, your highest and lowest, average pulse, and morning against evening.

items.title: A report for your doctor
items.text: A PDF with a summary, your categories, a chart and every reading, made on your iPhone and shared only when you choose.

items.title: Apple Watch and widgets
items.text: Add a reading from your wrist and it shows up on your iPhone. Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets keep your latest reading and averages in view.

items.title: Apple Health
items.text: Optional. Save your blood pressure and pulse to Apple Health, or add readings a connected blood pressure monitor saved there.

sections.label: AHA GUIDELINES
sections.title: Understand your numbers.
text: Every reading falls into one of the American Heart Association's five categories. When the two numbers disagree, the higher category counts. Pressure Easy is not a medical device and doesn't diagnose.

sections.label: PRIVACY
sections.title: Your health data stays yours.
text: No accounts. No cloud sync. No analytics. No ads. No tracking. Your readings stay on your iPhone and Apple Watch, and in Apple Health only if you turn it on. We never see them.

cta.title: Start tracking, privately.
cta.text: Free on the App Store. No account required.
